**Behaviour that moved.** All four are consequences of the ruled resolver meeting the renderer's UNCHANGED `item.title &&` / `item.description &&` gates (`renderer.tsx:1313, 1321`). Base: `true && h3{true}` draws an empty h3/p, `false` draws nothing, `0 && …` paints a bare `0` text node beside the line, whitespace draws a `p` holding spaces, padding is verbatim. Head: `'true'`/`'false'`/`'0'` inside the line; whitespace no line; trimmed. Identical to ObjectMap on the same inputs (its pin: `42`→`'42'`, `false`→`'false'`, `{id}` and `'   '`→no line; PR 10525 body: `0` now inside the paragraph). Plain-string author: `TimelineTitle` (h3, `index.tsx:97-107`) and `TimelineDescription` (p, `:121-131`) set no `whitespace-pre`, so surrounding spaces were already collapsed by HTML; trimming changes no visible text. A whitespace-only value loses an empty `p` and its margin; that is the same visual delta ObjectMap took, and no in-repo test pinned the old behaviour (grep for boolean/zero title/description pins in `plugin-timeline/src`: 0). Boolean text matches the resolver's own definition (`:480` "0 and false ARE values, not blanks"), ObjectMap (pinned), `ObjectGallery.tsx:681-684` (`String(item[titleField])` gives `'false'`) and `ObjectGantt.tsx:1107-1108`; the calendar and kanban drop `false` via their local re-spellings, which the resolver comment forbids.
